purpose.zh: 在高位屈髋时加阻力，练抬腿力量
purpose.en: Add resistance in deep hip flexion to build knee-drive strength.

text.zh: 站直扶墙，膝盖抬过髋的高度
text.en: Stand tall with a hand on the wall and drive your knee above hip height

text.zh: 顶端停2秒，骨盆不后倾、不弯腰
text.en: Hold for two seconds at the top without tucking the pelvis or bending over.
Lower the foot back to its spot slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 膝盖没抬到髋的高度就停
commonErrors.en: Stopping before the knee reaches hip height.

cautions.zh: 髋部前侧疼痛时减小抬膝高度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Lift lower if the front of your hip hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
